title: Nice in theory- not user friendly
text:
Nice in theory- not user friendly. Great in theory and wanted to help the environment.. But, this just doesn’t seem very feasible in reality. Feels like a prototype! The item itself comes in a small capsule which the straw telescopes in on itself… The cleaning brush is kept inside the collapsed straw as well. I do like the fact that this item can easily be contained on a lanyard or a keychain etc.. however, when fully assembled there are a few things that make it difficult to function and be satisfactory.
Each time one uses the collapsible straw-
you remove from case, take out cleaning brush and put cleaning brush inside capsule that stay closed up and reattaches to keychain or item of your choice until done using... and this is doable.

However, I am not certain how logical it is to store cleaning brush inside of straw? Yet, you want to house cleaning brush with you if using on the go… It will make clean up after use- so much easier. But, it seems like it’s not the most sanitary way to do this.. and sure, I understand the reasoning to keep size to a minimum, it just doesn’t feel sanitary!

Next, try as I might I can’t Rid of metallic/metal taste well using the straw… I did try some of the tricks offered online to rid the metallic aftertaste when using a canteen or, the likes… But, it didn’t seem to help? Maybe it’s mind over matter- or, planet over mind over matter??! Either way – this was not something I could get used to very easy.

Lastly, if you have ever used a large at straw for a milkshake? Be prepared for that type of opening with the straw.. it’s jumbo!! I realize the need for this with the telescoping closable feature but, this was the breaking point for me. Probably we’ve been spoiled in a world with plastic straws at an adequate size- I get it’s going to take a lot more tweaking and awareness to move away from the world with straws available at your leisure… BUT, this was not the end product I was hoping for- I believe there will be more revisions of the reusable straw in the future.. and they will trouble shoot these issues. So, I feel while people figure out the remedy for plastic straw consumption.. this is a middle step.. toward progress- not, perfection!

So, IF size of straw can be jumbo without bothering you AND metallic twang does not hinder your taste buds… AND you are not “germ afraid”’like myself – this may be something you’re interested in. As mentioned, the size and convenience of clipping this onto a keychain/backpack/wallet/lanyard is nice and let’s it be user ready when you need it..
